findings.title: cancel() doc comment still describes the old refund rule
findings.why: The comment says "Full refund before the booking starts, none once it has started". The code now refunds in full only when the cancellation is at least 24 hours before the start. A cancellation less than 24 hours before the start gets 0.

findings.title: 24-hour literal duplicates the existing DAY_MS constant
findings.why: `24 * 60 * 60 * 1000` repeats `DAY_MS`, which is defined at line 50 of the same file. Using `DAY_MS` would keep the refund window in one place.
